description: Price gaps for the same Arena instrument across Kalshi, Novig and Polymarket, worked out after each venue's taker fees. Without ref: live instruments ranked arbitrage first, then by the cheapest YES plus NO pair after fees, then by how far a venue is below Kalshi; each row names the game, every venue's price per side and, in where, which venue is below Kalshi or that Kalshi is lowest on both sides. With ref: every YES plus NO pair on that one instrument. Gaps are in cents (gap_cents). A pair buys YES on one venue and NO on another; cost is per $1 contract after fees, edge = 1 - cost. label is arbitrage only when the pair costs under $1 after fees on contracts that settle the same way, reviewed by a person, with sizes shown and both prices at most 15 seconds old; every other pair is a gap and reasons says why, word for word (for example 'Not risk-free: rules differ.'). Nothing here is risk-free: prices move and an order can fill worse or not at all. By default only venues a US user can use (Kalshi, Novig) can pair as arbitrage; us_only=false lets Polymarket pair too, whose prices are from its international exchange, which does not accept US persons. Every leg names its venue and as_of; re-read before acting, because a label lapses once a price is 15 seconds old. Arena is paper trading: it routes no order to Kalshi, Novig or Polymarket and has no partnership with any of them. No sign-in needed. Set full=true for every raw field; the notes stay.

league.description: The list only: one league, or all.

limit.description: The list only: at most this many instruments. Default 20.

min_gap.description: The list only: keep gaps of at least this many cents. Arbitrage is always kept.

ref.description: One instrument: an id such as ins_MBZ9SWMJTB0K, a slug, a Kalshi ticker, or a bet in words. Omit for the ranked list.

size.description: Contracts per leg to work the fees out for. Default 100.

us_only.description: Default true: only Kalshi and Novig can pair as arbitrage.

name: find_price_gaps
title: Find price gaps across venues
